edges.reason: earlyMint reads msg.sender to key earlyMintedTokensByOwner and mint to caller
earlyMint compares block.timestamp - mintingStartTime to enforce the first-day limit
earlyMint delegates minting to the internal _mint function
earlyMint increments earlyMintedTokensByOwner[msg.sender]
earlyMint validates the caller proof against the Merkle root through canMintEarly
mint calls the internal _mint function
mintToCommunityWallet calls mintNTokensFor to mint reserved tokens
mintNTokensFor loops calling _mintToken
_mint loops calling _mintToken for the requested count
_mintToken obtains the token id by calling randomIndex
_mintToken pushes the new id into ownerTokenList[to]
_mintToken writes NFTDetails into ownedTokensDetails[to][id]
_mintToken calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient
_mintToken stores block.timestamp as the token starTime
_mint distributes royalties by calling sendValueTo four times after minting
withdraw forwards the whole balance through sendValueTo
sendValueTo performs an unchecked low-level call with value
randomIndex mixes block.timestamp into the hash used to pick the index
randomIndex derives its randomness from block values controllable/influenceable by miners
randomIndex increments the nonce state variable after each draw
randomIndex reads and writes the indices swap-and-pop array
transferFrom updates token owner history before delegating to the parent transfer
safeTransferFrom updates token owner history before the safe transfer
safeTransferFrom triggers the onERC721Received callback on contract recipients
_updateTokenOwners writes block.timestamp into the endTime of the previous owner
_updateTokenOwners rewrites ownedTokensDetails entries for the new owner
_updateTokenOwners pushes the transferred id into ownerTokenList[to]
firstMints records block.timestamp as the token creation time
firstMints mints the initial tokens to communityAddress
firstMints initializes slots of the indices array
firstMints pushes the minted ids into ownerTokenList[communityAddress]
changeBaseURI overwrites the baseURI state variable
changeBaseURI emits msg.sender in the BaseURIChanged event
setProvenance stores the supplied hash into provenance
disableEarlyMinting flips the earlyMinting flag to false
disableBaseURIChanges flips the canChangeBaseURI flag to false
mintToCommunityWallet bounds the count against reservedTokens
mintToCommunityWallet increments mintedReservedTokens
_mint mints the purchased tokens to msg.sender

normalization_plan.reason: The _count parameter only bounds the mint loop inside earlyMint
The proof parameter is only consumed by earlyMint through the canMintEarly modifier
The uri string is only written into baseURI by changeBaseURI
The to_ address is the low-level call target used only inside sendValueTo
The value amount is the wei forwarded only inside sendValueTo
The from address is only used by transferFrom/_updateTokenOwners
The to address is only used by transferFrom/_updateTokenOwners
The tokenId is only forwarded by transferFrom to the ERC721 logic
The uint8 _count only sized the reserved mint loop in mintToCommunityWallet
The value local is the computed index returned by randomIndex
The index local is the selected slot computed inside randomIndex
The totalSize local is derived from totalSupply inside randomIndex
